topic: A person finds out their surprise party has been cancelled
text: Rain was slashing against the window when the call came. Should've known, the way the shadows were creeping in early, the way the wind had that edge to it. "Yeah,hello," I muttered, not bothering to hide the weight in my voice. The line hissed back, a voice that sounded as soaked as the pavement outside, telling me the party was a no-go. Just like that. No reason, just the click of the line and the silence that stretched out like a highway with no end. I ran a hand through my hair, feeling the weight of the city pressing down, the weight of plans laid bare and cold. I've seen cities swallow secrets and lies, but this? This felt like the loneliest game in town.
